facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_ReinforceAgent: create a ReinforceAgent that samples actions stochastically or deterministically based on agent_info mode

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.build_BaselineModel: build a BaselineModel neural network that computes state value V(s) from observation frames

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.test_Model: test the Model class that wraps an ActionModel and BaselineModel as a PyTorch module

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.create_gym_env_gym_make: create a gym environment by name using gym.make for CartPole-v0
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.review_Experiment_class: review the Experiment class that extends Reinforce for RL training

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.run_REINFORCE_training: run the Reinforce class to train a reinforcement learning agent using policy gradient with baseline and entropy regularization

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.compute_REINFORCE_loss: compute the REINFORCE loss including baseline loss, entropy loss, and average reward from sampled trajectories
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.review_REINFORCE_get_loss: review the get_loss method that calculates discounted cumulative rewards and policy gradient loss components
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.refactor_REINFORCE_run: refactor the run method training loop to support custom optimizers or different loss weighting strategies
